description: Realm pride and realm talk from Living Server, rewritten: every line is said in its own realm only.

lines.text: Hibs keep complaining about our Clerics, must be doing something right.
Mids think Trolls are subtle, I heard one from three hills away.
Highlanders yelling in a group is my favorite sound in the realm.
Avalons always look like they are about to correct your spelling.
Inconnu give me the shivers, glad they picked our side.
Saracens are the best looking race in any realm, no further questions.
Briton is the plain choice and it never lets you down.
I was raised on old king Arthur stories, this realm feels like home.
Long live the king, wherever he wandered off to.
Albion was here first and the other two know it.
Our music is all lutes and flutes, not drums and shouting.
Minstrels are basically the realm's town criers with a lute.
Ever notice Albion guards look like they could actually fight?
Reavers are what happens when the church loses track of a knight.
Necromancers creep me out but I want one in every group.
Theurgist pets everywhere, the whole realm sounds like a beehive.
Mercenaries are just armsmen who skipped the sermons.
Scouts are the realm's eyes and most of its complaints.
Every Infiltrator swears he fights fair. I have my doubts.
Hibs dye everything purple, and call it stealth.
A Kobold asked me for directions once. Then he stabbed me. Typical Midgard.
A Friar with a quarterstaff is the most Albion thing there is.
I trust a Cleric with a mace over any Druid with a twig.
The church of Albion has rules for everything, even for fun.
Albion breeds stubborn people, it is all the rain.
Sometimes I stop on a hill just to look at the countryside.
Anyone else think Albion has the best castles of the three realms?
What do you think makes Albion better than the other two?
Albs argue about everything, then line up behind the same banner.
There is a guild for everything in Albion, probably a guild for guilds too.
The guild of shadows is not half as secret as it thinks.
The academy smells like old books and singed eyebrows.
I like how Albion feels old, like the stones remember things.
A hot stew in a tavern after a long hunt, that is Albion.
The Mids eat raw fish, the Hibs eat flowers, we eat proper food.
Albion has the best castles, the other realms have the best excuses.
A good Alb knows that a sword is only as good as the arm behind it.
I like the sound of church bells in an Albion village.
The other realms have magic, we have magic and manners.
Saracens and Highlanders in the same group, the arguments never end.
My mentor said a true Alb never runs, then he ran.
The realm feels bigger every year, or I walk slower.
How many Mids does it take to light a torch? None, the Troll already ate it.
Why did the Lurikeen cross the road? He could not see over the hedge.
I tried to teach a Troll to read, it did not go well.
Heard the Hibs train their pets to cry when an Alb walks by.
Mids say we wear too much armor. They say it from the floor.
Albion plate shines brighter than anything a Mid ever hammered.
The other realms got the pretty zones and we got the rain, typical.
Why is it always raining in Albion, I rust just looking at it?
Too many Infiltrators in this realm, nobody wants to heal.
After all these levels I still get a little proud when I see the Albion banner.
Seen a lot of Albs come and go, the realm keeps going.
Albion smiths know plate better than anyone, ask any Alb crafter.
A well made Albion breastplate is worth every coin, the Hibs can keep their cloth.
I have walked every road in Albion and I still find new corners.
Every old ruin in Albion has a story, I want to hear all of them.
The best thing about Albion is the people, even the grumpy ones.
Love how friendly Albion is, even the guards say hello.
An Alb is never more alive than when outnumbered.
Albs hide behind their pretty walls and call it courage.
A Troll in a doorway is the best wall a realm can have.
Kobolds are small but they hold grudges forever.
Dwarves will argue about anything, mostly ale.
Norseman is the plain pick and plain is strong.
Valkyn are strange but they fight like wolves.
Albs clank so loud you can hear them a zone away.
Hibs sparkle so much, explains how we always find them.
Heh, Hibs think the cold is our weakness. It is our home.
In Midgard even the trees want to fight you.
A Mid without a beard is just a Kobold standing up straight.
Odin is watching. Try not to die stupid.
Thor would never pull a whole room on purpose. Most of the time.
The sagas will not remember who sat in town.
I like that our songs are loud and our ale is strong.
Berserkers are the reason Albs check behind them.
Hunters and their hounds are the backbone of every Mid road trip.
Shadowblades complain the most and kill the most, funny how that works.
Healers keep this realm standing, never forget it.
Shamans are the friend who brings the cure and the poison both.
Runemasters say the runes talk to them. I believe it.
Spiritmasters have the creepiest pets in Midgard and I love them.
Bonedancers walk around with a skeleton army like it is normal.
Thanes call down lightning just to light a pipe.
Warriors do not say much, they just stand in the way of things.
An Alb told me Midgard is all snow, has he never seen a swamp.
Midgard does not ask for respect, it takes it.
A Mid funeral is just a louder party.
The houses argue among themselves, but never in front of an Alb.
The cold keeps us honest and the mead keeps us warm.
Every Mid has a scar story, and most of them are true.
Longships, beards and bad tempers, that is Midgard.
A Kobold with a grudge is the most dangerous thing in the realm.
Trolls are slow to anger and slower to forget.
Albs think we are wild, we think they are tin cans with opinions.
Hibs think we are loud, we think they are hard to see, both true.
Anyone else think Midgard has the best sky at night?
What do you think the Albs fear most about us?
My grandfather said a Mid never backs down from a fight, then he ran to the tavern.
A proper Mid eats like a Troll and fights like a storm.
I love the sound of a forge in a Midgard village after a cold day.
Dwarves and Kobolds in the same group, every pull turns into an argument.
The gods of Midgard like a good fight, so we give them one.
A Valkyn walked past me in town and I still do not know what it was.
Why do Trolls make bad stealthers? They keep sitting on the bushes.
A Lurikeen fell in my mead once, I drank it anyway.
Albs wear so much plate they rust when they cry.
Heard the Albs pray before every pull. We just yell.
An Alb challenged a Troll to a staring contest, the Alb lost.
Mid steel is the only steel worth swinging.
Proud to be a Mid, best fighters in the land and nobody can say different.
The snow is pretty until you have walked through it for an hour.
My boots are frozen again, Midgard life.
Too many Shadowblades in this realm, nobody wants to heal.
Seen a lot of Mids come and go, the realm keeps roaring.
A well made Midgard axe is worth every coin.
I have walked every frozen road in Midgard and I still find new corners.
Every old runestone in Midgard has a story, I want to read all of them.
The best thing about Midgard is the people, even the loud ones. Especially the loud ones.
Love how loud Midgard is, even the guards shout hello.
A Mid is never more alive than when outnumbered and grinning.
Albs laugh at our colors until they get mesmerized.
Firbolgs are the gentlest giants you will ever meet, until you anger one.
Lurikeens are small but they have the loudest opinions in the realm.
Elves pretend not to care about anything, they care about everything.
Celts fit in anywhere, and they fight like it.
Sylvans are trees with opinions, and I love them.
Mids think Lurikeens are soft, let them keep thinking it.
Mids smell like wet wolf and burnt mead.
Albs wear so much metal they forget to bring a brain.
A Bard with a harp can make a whole group forget they are tired.
Druids keep this realm growing, in more ways than one.
Wardens are the quiet ones who save the group and never mention it.
Blademasters spin like they are dancing, and the Albs fall over.
Champions hit you with a spell and a sword, rude but effective.
Heroes are the walls of Hibernia and they know it.
Rangers see everything, then complain about it.
Nightshades are why Mids walk around in circles.
Eldritches burn bright and die fast, but what a show.
Mentalists heal and mez and still get no respect.
Animists plant mushrooms and the mushrooms do the fighting, that is Hibernia.
Valewalkers with scythes look like a harvest gone wrong, I love it.
I love that even our roads look like a painting.
The faeries here are friendly. Mostly. Some of them.
Hibernia smells like rain and wildflowers, the other realms smell like smoke.
A Lurikeen on a horse is the bravest thing in the realm.
Albs pray, Mids shout, Hibs sing, and we are the happiest realm for it.
The path of harmony, the path of focus, the path of essence, and the path to the tavern.
Hibernia is full of old magic and older grudges.
Firbolgs make the best friends, they never forget a kindness.
Anyone else think Hibernia has the best music of the three realms?
What do you think is the prettiest zone in Hibernia?
I love the sound of a harp in a Hibernian village after a long day.
Elves and Lurikeens in the same group, the jokes never end.
The sidhe left us the loveliest places in the world and the Albs want them, of course.
A Sylvan stood still so long in town that a Bard leaned on it.
A Mid asked me why Lurikeens are so short. To stay out of Troll reach, obviously.
Why do Albs wear so much plate? So the mez has something to bounce off.
Heard the Albs need a priest to tie their boots.
An Alb challenged a Lurikeen to a race, he never saw where the Lurikeen went.
Too many rangers in this realm, nobody wants to heal.
Why does it always rain in Hibernia, the flowers love it?
Seen a lot of Hibs come and go, the realm keeps singing.
A well made Hibernian bow is worth every coin, the Albs can keep their tin.
I have walked every green road in Hibernia and I still find new corners.
Every old stone circle in Hibernia has a story, I want to hear all of them.
The best thing about Hibernia is the people, even the moody Elves.
Love how warm Hibernia is, even the guards hum along.
Midgard: bigger axes, better beards.
Nothing beats a Skald speed run home.
The other realms fear a Midgard group with a good healer.
Albion casters, the light show of the frontier.
A Cleric and an Armsman, the oldest friendship in Albion.
The other realms wish they had our Wizards.
Hibernia: we mez you, then we sing about it.
The other realms still have not figured out our Druids.
